stories.title: Manchester City 2-2 Napoli, Real Madrid 5-1 PSV: Champions League clockwatch – as it happened
summary: Manchester City were frustrated again while Jude Bellingham inspired Real Madrid to go goal crazy in the second half There’s been a shot on target now, and it’s only gone in!

It’s from a corner – one of those where the defender ushers the ball out of play thinking he’s about to get a goal-kick only for the fourth official to point to the corner – from which Yilmaz heads goalwards, the ball loops up off Jackson, and Deniz Gul heads it in!

Not only that, just after he does so he gets volleyed in the face by Nicolas Jackson, who was a bit late in trying to clear the ball.The two early kick-offs are now into their 75th minute, and still none of the four teams have had a shot on target.

summary: Manchester United and Mauricio Pochettino are furious at how Leny Yoro's red card has been handled by VAR John Brooks and referees' chief Howard Webb

stories.title: Rayan Cherki magic denies Napoli but Manchester City’s struggles continue
summary: For reasons best known to those eyeing the pound signs, Manchester City gave a debut to a special rust-coloured kit in front of a nonplussed crowd.

Nobody could pretend City were up against crack opposition in a one-paced Napoli, who are eighth in Serie A and lack the brio of old, but they simply cannot keep the door shut and could not have quibbled about departing with a defeat.

stories.title: Dortmund’s Beier halts Arsenal charge after thunderbolt from Gyökeres
summary: For the second time in four days, Mikel Arteta’s side found themselves a goal up at half-time and apparently coasting toward victory, only for their opponents to rouse themselves and earn a deserved draw.
After Newcastle on Saturday, this time it was an impressive Borussia Dortmund who became only the second side to take points off Arsenal in their past 15 group stage games in this competition.

The German side had to hang on for a result that gave their travelling fans a night to remember, although Arteta admitted his players must be more clinical when Real Madrid and Jude Bellingham visit north London in a fortnight.

stories.title: Pochettino criticises Premier League officiating after Yoro red card overturned
summary: Manchester United defender wrongly sent off in 4-0 loss‘If we have VAR, what were they doing?’ asks head coachMauricio Pochettino has criticised officiating in English football, saying: “We have an unbelievable car, but we need to be in the level to drive [it],” after Leny Yoro’s Anfield red card was overturned on Tuesday.Despite the Football Association ruling the Frenchman’s early sending-off in Sunday’s 4-0 defeat at Liverpool was “wrongful dismissal”, Manchester United remain furious at the decision, and at Pro Ref, the elite officials’ organisation.

stories.title: Man Utd target Collins - Wednesday's gossip

stories.title: ‘I botched it’: Singer apologizes for O Canada errors before Maple Leafs-Islanders game
summary: Sarrah Strimel Bentley made mess of anthem in New York‘I’m really sorry,’ said Bentley following online criticismGiven the somewhat tense nature of relations between the United States and Canada right now, the last thing the person tasked with singing the national anthems at an NHL game would want to do is mess up any lyrics, but that is exactly what Sarrah Strimel Bentley did, leading to an emotional apology.Bentley, a former Broadway actor, repeatedly got the words to O Canada wrong before the Toronto Maple Leafs’ game against New York Islanders at UBS Arena on Monday.

stories.title: Gul takes pain for buoyant Galatasaray to condemn Aston Villa to Champions League loss
summary: This was Aston Villa’s third trip to Istanbul in the calendar year but, this time, they departed with different emotions.

It was the game’s first effort on target, Galatasaray maintaining their commanding form on home soil to extend Villa’s winless run to six matches in all competitions.On the outside, this is a gladiatorial arena, a giant spaceship parked on Ali Sami Yen complex.

John McGinn, one of four changes from Villa’s stalemate with Sunderland on Saturday, gestured towards the turf in frustration after a through ball went awry, but nobody of a Villa persuasion could blame defeat on the surface.

stories.title: Bayern hold 'constructive' talks over Musiala's health
summary: Bayern Munich are only focused on getting Jamal Musiala back from injury and not interested in the comments made regarding his contract, the club's sporting director Max Eberl insists.

stories.title: Georgia Tech couple clears up viral televised argument during football game
summary: Tallulah Wall and Braden Flournoy says their discussion that riveted viewers ‘was completely insignificant’A couple whose heated discussion in the stands of a recent college football game in Atlanta was nationally and virally televised has spoken out about the experience – saying it ended up being how most of the people in their lives learned they were dating.Georgia Tech students Tallulah Wall and Braden Flournoy appeared on NBC’s Today show on Tuesday, three days after ESPN showed them having an intense conversation while watching their school’s football team lose resoundingly in their home stadium to Wake Forest.

stories.title: Florian Wirtz hails Iraola and Klopp as he reaches new levels for Liverpool
summary: Wirtz scored an exquisite improvised goal in the 4-0 defeat of Manchester United on Sunday when he also created 10 chances from open play.

stories.title: Jannik Sinner’s Australian Open appearance in doubt after knee surgery
summary: Wimbledon champion sidelined since winning title‘We’ve tried everything to treat injury without surgery’Jannik Sinner faces further time off the court after undergoing knee surgery.
While no timeline for recovery has yet been set out, it seems almost certain to rule out a comeback for the Australian Open in January, as had been the intention.

stories.title: Teen star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi blitzes through record books with 53-ball 204
summary: India A batter breaks sixes record with 28 against UAECaptain Tilak Varma: ‘I would say it’s absolute carnage’The teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hammered 204 off 53 balls for India A on Tuesday to break a host of records, including for the fastest century and double-century in List A cricket.The 15-year-old Sooryavanshi struck a staggering 28 sixes, the most in a senior men’s innings, as India passed their target of 250 against the United Arab Emirates in just 14.2 overs.

stories.title: Cowan-Dickie insists England will not let up after record triumph over All Blacks
summary: The Sale hooker was part of the squad who defeated the All Blacks in the 2019 World Cup semi-final in emphatic fashion and went into the final against South Africa as favourites.
Eddie Jones’s side were comfortably outplayed by the Springboks, however, with Cowan-Dickie acknowledging that England failed to hit their emotional peak that day.

stories.title: 2028 Copa América to be played in United States with six Concacaf teams
summary: South American tournament was in US in 2024 and 2016Concacaf teams determined by 2027 Gold CupGames will overlap with Euro 2028 but not OlympicsThe 2028 Copa América will be played in the United States and expanded to include teams from the Concacaf region, bringing the landmark South American international competition to the US for a third time in five editions.Conmebol, the South American confederation that runs the tournament, and Concacaf, the confederation governing soccer in North and Central America and the Caribbean, jointly announced the long-rumored arrangement on Tuesday, framing it as an extension of a “strategic partnership” between the organizations.

stories.title: Dynamic pricing to be used for games in US during 2031 Women’s World Cup
summary: Ticketing model was in place for 2026 men’s World CupFans criticized system but Fifa saw record revenuesA dynamic pricing model is set to be used in ticket sales for games held in the United States at the 2031 Women’s World Cup, which will be co-hosted with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica.Sources involved with the bid, which was formally ratified by Fifa on Monday, have told the Guardian it is inevitable that variable pricing will be used in the US after its successful application at last summer’s men’s World Cup, which generated about $5bn in ticket sales and hospitality, a significant increase on Fifa’s projection of $3.3bn.

stories.title: 'Something switched inside me': Nick Foles on his Super Bowl flow state and move behind the mic
summary: Not the record 1,151 yards of combined offense or the nerve-shredding go-ahead touchdown drive or the surreal theater of a second-string quarterback outdueling Tom Brady on the biggest stage in American sports.

Not even the moment Brady’s last-gasp Hail Mary pass fell harmlessly to the turf and the Philadelphia Eagles became champions of the National Football League for the first time since the Eisenhower administration.Instead, he remembers holding his daughter.
